name: cf-cdn-input-validator
description: Validates the operator-filled user_input.csv against dns_manifest.yaml to ensure every proxied domain is accounted for with valid default cache behavior selection (Y/N) and optional ACM certificate ARN. Checks for required columns, valid enum values, correct ARN format, and completeness against the manifest. On success, produces domain_scope.json — a machine-readable domain registry enriched with origin content and type from the manifest, consumed by all downstream CDN pipeline subagents. Reports validation errors with clear remediation hints.
